versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Rental Car Return Shield, a comprehensive toolkit for rental car inspection, fuel strategies, secure drop-off, and post-return dispute defense.
- Includes checklists for 18-shot pickup photos, 10 pre-drive checks, and unmarked-damage protocol to prevent unfair damage claims.
- Provides decision guidance for fuel options (self-refuel, company service, prepaid traps, EV return rules) with detailed cost calculations.
- Step-by-step defended drop-off process (including after-hours protocol and securing a no-damage receipt) to block post-return claims.
- Full dispute kit: documentation, timeline, evidence indexing, dispute letter template, and chargeback guidance.
- Verification checklist ensures all procedures are followed and evidence is retained until liability risk ends.
